reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: Wanted to use it, but the vibration haptic feedback was stressful and the additional insights of the healthiness standard deviation of the heart rate sounded like pseudoscience.

reviews.title: Horrible, stressful app
reviews.text: There’s so much going on with this app and it’s gonna tell you you’re stressed all the time. No matter what I was doing or what time of day, the app told me I was stressed and needed rest. I took my measurement when I just woke up, it came back 82% stressed. I need rest. Tool measurement when I was laying outside in my hammock, reading a book on a beautiful day, feeling so relaxed yet the app told me I was 79% stressed and needed a rest. This freaking app makes you stressed.!

reviews.title: Only works 50% of time…
reviews.text: Always ‘preparing’ - hardly ever actually measures & I got fed up of always waiting! I’m not sure I trust results either. Just my experience.

reviews.title: Now you have to pay, if you want to use the measuring 🙄
reviews.text:
If you don’t pay, the app is now almost useless. How greedy can you be? 
Now you have to pay 6.99 per month if you want to use the basic measurement feature. We give you all our data for free and now you want us to pay you to give you all our heart and movement data? Greed at its finest. I deinstalled the app. Companies like that deserve to go broke.

reviews.title: apps clearly just fake
reviews.text: was finding in accurate results so put the camera on a peice of orange paper said it had a heart rate of 109bpm , also my bf has this app also and he got 98bpm on his but only 63bmp on mines literally took the test 2 mins apparently its all just fake cant measure anything

reviews.title: Renewal Without Notice, can’t cancel
reviews.text: App stopped working after trial. Started billing me without app functionality. No notice near end of 7 day trial.
